title: Mon 12 Oct 2026: Wall Street rallies as oil eases, BoE November hike debate, FCA transaction reporting consultation, European ETF firsts
summary: Stocks rally on Friday after President Trump says the US will not attack Iran before the midterms, easing oil and Treasury yields, while sources differ on the odds of a Bank of England hike on 5 November. In regulation, a new FCA transaction reporting consultation and a cluster of asset management deadlines. Plus European ETF firsts, three COO action points and the diary for the coming weeks.
